SAMPLE VERSES

BY NOBODY

CONTENTS

I. THE LANTERN
II. THE PALLID BUST

[Transcriber's note: line numbers removed.]


THE LANTERN.

I.

The lantern swings above the pallid bust,
A hollow wind goes whispering through the hall;
The clock has stopped, the candle turned to dust,
And nothing moves, and nothing moves at all.

The pallid bust is watching from the shelf,
Its marble eyes are open, cold and wide;
I keep a hollow wind inside myself
And o'er the floor the shadows slowly glide.


THE PALLID BUST.

II.

To-day the garden sleeps beneath the frost,
The bee is gone, the clover gone to seed;
'Tis not the summer only that is lost,
A hollow wind is all the dead will need.

The marble eyes have seen the lantern swing,
The marble eyes have seen the candle fail;
And still the pallid bust says not a thing,
And still the hollow wind goes on its trail.

The clover and the bee will come again,
The frost will loose its fingers from the ground;
But what the lantern saw, the marble eyes,
Stay sleeping with the lantern, dark and drowned.

*** END OF THE PROJECT GUTENBERG EBOOK SAMPLE VERSES ***
